name: AP Physics 1
description: Scorpio's roadmap through the eight AP Physics 1 units: ready-made, auto-graded sets in a teaching order.

sets.title: Describing motion
sets.description: Scalars and vectors, displacement, average velocity and average acceleration in one dimension.

sets.title: Representing motion
sets.description: Reading motion from position and velocity graphs and the kinematic equations.

sets.title: Reference frames and relative motion
sets.description: Velocities measured from moving frames: trains, walkways, boats and currents.

sets.title: Projectile motion
sets.description: Horizontal and angled launches with independent horizontal and vertical motion.

sets.title: Systems and free-body diagrams
sets.description: Centre of mass, internal and external forces, and drawing the forces on an object.

sets.title: Newton's three laws
sets.description: Interaction pairs, constant velocity, and net force producing acceleration.

sets.title: Gravity and friction
sets.description: Apparent weight, gravity at altitude, and static and kinetic friction.

sets.title: Springs and circular motion
sets.description: Spring forces and the net inward force in circular motion.

sets.title: Kinetic energy and work
sets.description: Kinetic energy, work by constant and varying forces, and the sign of work.

sets.title: Potential energy
sets.description: Gravitational and elastic potential energy and the choice of zero.

sets.title: Conservation of energy
sets.description: Energy bar charts, friction losses and energy conservation in systems.

sets.title: Energy problems and power
sets.description: Multi-step energy problems, and power as the rate of energy transfer.

sets.title: Momentum of objects and systems
sets.description: Momentum as a vector: single objects, two-object systems and changes in momentum.

sets.title: Impulse and change in momentum
sets.description: Impulse from average force and force–time graphs, and how it changes momentum.

sets.title: Conservation of momentum
sets.description: Isolated systems, explosions and pushes, and centre-of-mass motion.

sets.title: Elastic and inelastic collisions
sets.description: Sticking and bouncing collisions: momentum conserved, kinetic energy not always.

sets.title: Rotational kinematics
sets.description: Angular displacement, speed and acceleration, and linking them to linear motion.

sets.title: Torque
sets.description: Torque from force, lever arm and angle; net torque and balanced torques.

sets.title: Rotational inertia and equilibrium
sets.description: How mass distribution sets rotational inertia, and static equilibrium of rigid bodies.

sets.title: Newton's second law for rotation
sets.description: Net torque = Iα: pulleys, hanging masses and pivoted rods.

sets.title: Rotational kinetic energy and work
sets.description: Rotational kinetic energy and the work done by a torque.

sets.title: Angular momentum and angular impulse
sets.description: Angular momentum of rigid bodies and point masses, and angular impulse.

sets.title: Conservation of angular momentum
sets.description: Spinning skaters, dropped masses and tethered systems with no external torque.

sets.title: Rolling and orbits
sets.description: Rolling without slipping with energy, and angular momentum in elliptical orbits.

sets.title: Restoring forces and period
sets.description: What makes motion simple harmonic, and what the period does and does not depend on.

sets.title: Period and frequency
sets.description: Measuring and calculating periods of springs and pendulums.

sets.title: Analysing SHM
sets.description: Position, velocity and acceleration through an oscillation.

sets.title: Energy of oscillators
sets.description: Kinetic and potential energy exchange in springs and pendulums.

sets.title: Density and pressure
sets.description: Density, absolute and gauge pressure, and pressure with depth.

sets.title: Pressure forces and buoyancy
sets.description: Forces from pressure differences, and buoyant force on floating and tethered objects.

sets.title: Buoyancy and Newton's laws
sets.description: Net force and acceleration of submerged objects; what buoyancy does and does not depend on.

sets.title: Fluid flow and Bernoulli
sets.description: Continuity, Bernoulli's equation and Torricelli's law.
